hero.headline: 70 Years of Striving for the Highest (1956 – 2026)
hero.subHeadline: Celebrating seven decades of Academic Excellence, Character Building, and Service to Humanity.

strategicPillars.title: Academic Excellence
strategicPillars.description: Nurturing young minds through modern technology and innovation.

strategicPillars.title: Character Building
strategicPillars.description: Repositioning the system for disciplined leadership.

strategicPillars.title: Service to Humanity
strategicPillars.description: A commitment to the progress of Abeokuta and Nigeria at large.

about.heritage: Founded in 1956, Ebenezer Grammar School Abeokuta (EGSA) has remained a citadel of learning and a powerhouse for producing distinguished Nigerians. For 70 years, we have lived by our motto: "STRIVE FOR THE HIGHEST".

leadershipMessages.name: Engr. Tajudeen Olórí
leadershipMessages.message: Education is critical to the future of our society. A well-educated population is less likely to engage in negative activities. We appeal to the government to remain committed to its educational policies while we continue strengthening the school for greater excellence.

leadershipMessages.name: Engr. Dr. Adekunle Musa, FNSE
leadershipMessages.message: The Platinum Jubilee is more than a celebration; it is a renewal of our commitment to our alma mater.

leadershipMessages.name: Engr. Alhaji Samsideen Adedeji Suleiman
leadershipMessages.message: Extending heartfelt congratulations to the entire dedicated staff and old students.

events.title: The Grand Finale
events.highlight: Unveiling of the Commemorative Monument and the Launch of the Endowment Fund.

achievements.title: NSE "Engineering and You" Competition
achievements.description: Students won the 2025 Engineering and You competition organised by the Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE), Abeokuta Branch.

achievements.title: ANCHOPSS National Debate
achievements.description: Emerged victorious at the Association of Nigerian Conference of Principals of Secondary Schools (ANCHOPSS) national debate competition held in Imo State.

achievements.title: Campus Security Transformation
achievements.description: Through collaboration between alumni, government, and security agencies, the school environment was transformed from a security-challenged zone into a secure, fenced, and conducive learning environment.

achievements.title: Dual ICT Centre Partnership
achievements.description: Established two ICT centres in partnership with the Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC) and the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA), ensuring students are CBT-ready.

legacy.purpose: To enhance Computer-Based Tests (CBT) and global competitiveness for all students.

itCenters.name: USPF/NCC IT Centre
itCenters.donor: Universal Service Provision Fund and Nigerian Communications Commission

infrastructure.safeSpace: Transforming the school from a "den of miscreants" into a secure, fenced, and conducive learning environment.
infrastructure.completed: Renovated classrooms and hostels, a modern library, new boreholes, furniture, and perimeter fencing.
infrastructure.upcoming: Construction of the 70th Anniversary Commemorative Monument.

giveBack.endowmentFund: Launched during the 70th Anniversary, this fund ensures the long-term sustainability of school projects and supports indigent students with examination fees and scholarships.

merchandise.name: Platinum Jubilee Polo
merchandise.description: White with navy collar and 70th Anniversary Logo.

contact.address: Ebenezer Grammar School, Iberekodo, Abeokuta, Ogun State.

alumni.intro: EGSAOSA is powered by a vibrant network of old students spanning over four decades. 28 graduation sets are registered and actively contributing to the school's development.
